popCulture.title: Rhesus (play)
popCulture.description: The Attic tragedy (often kept under Euripides' name) restages the Iliad's night raid — Rhesus' arrival and death as a self-contained war play.

popCulture.title: Rhesus of Thrace
popCulture.description: The Thracian king whose snow-white horses Odysseus and Diomedes steal remains the Iliad's most famous nocturnal ambush.
